title: Textile — DPP characteristics

modelNumber.title: Model Number
modelNumber.description: Manufacturer's model number or variant identifier
modelNumber.x-provision: GPSR (EU) 2023/988 Art. 9(5) — type, batch, serial number or other identifying element
modelNumber.x-citationNote: Art. 9(5) requires a type, batch or serial number (or other identifying element) that is easily visible and legible to consumers — on the product, or on its packaging or an accompanying document. The duty is to IDENTIFY the product, not specifically to publish in a passport; carrying it here satisfies the identification and is the natural home for it. Verified against the EUR-Lex text.
